Title: Question about Out of the Frying Pan

Messages.Author: CARL BRAUN
Messages.Body:
I know this maybe stupid but, what about a clan like the Salubri where
the clan itself is independent by default. Does this card make a
!Salubri into a Salubri even though the clan it self is not Cam? I
would assume this could make a non-Scarce normal Salubri?
Card text:
Out of the frying Pan
Master. Trifle
Choose a ready sabat vampire you control. That vampire becomes
Camarilla. (His or her Clan is not affected.)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Xian wrote:
> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
>>CARL BRAUN wrote:
>>>Does this card make a
>>>!Salubri into a Salubri even though the clan it self is not Cam?

>>>I would assume this could make a non-Scarce normal Salubri?
>>No. Clan Impersonation could do that, though.
> It wouldn't actually make the Salubri **non-scarce**, though, would
> it?

It would.

A !Salubri who Clan Impersonates a Salubri would be a non-scarce
normal Salubri.

A Salubri who Clan Impersonates a !Salubri would be a scarce !Salubri
(not a "non-scarce normal Salubri", which seems to be how you've
interpreted the phrase).

> You only get that if you Embrace, or somehow create another
> vampire with a Salubri, I expect?

Or Clan Impersonate to change clans to Salubri.
